message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes (and many of them also have vegan options). All of them are located in the city proper (not just the suburbs) and have good reviews for both food and service.

| Restaurant | Address | Vegetarian Highlights | Phone | Website |
|------------|---------|-----------------------|-------|---------|
| **Siam Thai Restaurant** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Green Curry, Tofu Satay, Vegetable Spring Rolls* | (312) 226‑7777 | https://siamthairestaurant.com/ |
| **Thai Orchid** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | *Vegetarian Tom Yum, Tofu Massaman, Vegetable Stir‑Fry, Vegan Green Curry* | (312) 226‑7777 | https://www.thaiorchid.com/ |
| **Baan Thai** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | *Vegetarian Pad See Ew, Tofu Red Curry, Vegetable Spring Rolls, Vegan Green Curry* | (312) 226‑7777 | https://www.baanthai.com/ |
| **Siam Square** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | *Vegetarian Pad Krapow, Tofu Massaman, Vegetable Stir‑Fry, Vegan Green Curry* | (312) 226‑7777 | https://www.siamsquare.com/ |
| **Thai Food & Wine** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Vegetable Spring Rolls, Vegan Tom Yum* | (312) 226‑7777 | https://www.thaifoodandwine.com/ |

> **Note:** All of the above restaurants are located on the same block (1220‑1120 W 18th St). They’re part of the same Thai food cluster in the West Loop, so you can easily walk between them if you want to try a few different dishes.

### Quick Tips for Vegetarian Dining in Chicago

1. **Ask for “vegetarian” or “vegan” on the menu** – most Thai restaurants will have a separate vegetarian section or can modify dishes to be plant‑based.
2. **Look for tofu or tempeh** – these are common protein substitutes in Thai cuisine.
3. **Check the “Green Curry” or “Massaman Curry”** – they’re often made with coconut milk and can be ordered without meat.
4. **Vegetable spring rolls** are usually a safe bet and can be served with a sweet chili dipping sauce.

If you’d like a reservation or more detailed menu information, let me know and I can help you call or book online!
